# Carcavelos Daily Brief — Tuesday 2nd June

**Small, fun waves with a building swell and consistent offshore wind make this a solid beginner-friendly day.**

**Morning (03:19–11:00)**
Kick off early for the cleanest conditions. Waves hover around 1.1–1.2m with light NNW offshore wind (13–16km/h) until 09:00. The 07:00–09:00 window is your sweet spot—glassy, manageable peaks, minimal crowd. Swell period softens slightly through the morning but stays rideable.

**Progression**
Wind fills in from 11:00 onwards, jumping to 20–24km/h by early afternoon. Waves build gradually to 1.3m+ by 18:00. Chop increases but remains workable for intermediate surfers.

**Afternoon (12:00–18:00)**
Less polished but more powerful. Better for those seeking a bit of punch. Sunset session (16:00–17:51) offers slightly stronger faces.

**Tips**
• Go early if you want clean peelers  
• Bring a shortboard—small waves need drive  
• Avoid the 14:00–16:00 peak wind window if you prefer glass
